notes: §1985:VI.6.18.4 GR15 (old GR13, renumbered by Amendment 2): CHARACTERS replaces 'each character matched, in the sense of general rule 7e', ALL each occurrence matched, LEADING 'the first and each successive contiguous occurrence ..., provided that the leftmost occurrence is at the point where comparison began in the first comparison cycle in which literal-1 was eligible to participate', and FIRST 'the leftmost occurrence of literal-1 matched ... This rule applies to each successive specification of the FIRST phrase regardless of the value of literal-1'. CobolInspect.Replace runs the one comparison cycle (RunCycle) over the original content and writes each hit into a copy: Put writes literal-3 (a figurative filled to the matched size) over an ALL, LEADING or FIRST hit, a CHARACTERS hit takes the one replacement character; each FIRST operand carries its own live flag, cleared at its first hit, and a LEADING run is anchored by OpenLeadingAnchors exactly as in tallying; InspectEmitter.EmitBody stores the image back once. At 85 the scan is always left to right, so the first occurrence encountered is the leftmost: VersionConformancePass.VisitInspectStatement refuses BACKWARD below 2023 (COBOL0845, probed). Probed at --std 85 beyond the witness: the replacing halves of the standard's own examples 1 to 4 (§1985:VI.6.18.5, eleven rows, every final value as printed), identifier patterns and replacements, figurative replacements, three FIRST phrases of which two name the same literal, a LEADING operand whose anchor an earlier FIRST consumed (replaces nothing), and signed, edited and group identifier-1. The witness exercises the four adjectives over seven statements. The BEFORE with AFTER boundary defect of kb/Work PB5120 is §1985:VI.6.18.4 GR8's, not this rule's.

next.reason: Amendment 2 (X3.23b-1993, page VI-99) renumbered this rule (old GR13) and its reference in a ('general rule 6e' to 'general rule 7e'); the requirement is the printed one. a and b recur word for word in §2023:14.9.22.4 GR17 ('each character matched, in the sense of General rule 8e': numbering; 'each occurrence of literal-1 matched in the content of the data item referenced by identifier-1 is replaced by literal-3'). c and d differ. c: §1985:VI.6.18.4 GR15 'provided that the leftmost occurrence is at the point where comparison began', §2023:14.9.22.4 GR17 'provided that the first such occurrence encountered is at the point where comparison began'. d: 1985 'the leftmost occurrence of literal-1 matched within the content of the data item referenced by identifier-1 is replaced by literal-3', 2023 'the leftmost occurrence of literal-1, or, if BACKWARD is specified, the rightmost occurrence of literal-1 matched'. Left to right both name the same occurrence, so every 1985 INSPECT replaces the same characters; under BACKWARD (§2023:14.9.22.2 prints an optional 'BACKWARD' before identifier-1), which 1985 refuses (§1985:VI.6.18.2 prints identifier-1 directly after INSPECT), 2023 d replaces the rightmost occurrence where the 1985 words name the leftmost, and c takes the occurrence first met from the right. d adds its case in the same form as §2023:14.9.22.4 GR3 adds one to 1985-GR-VI.6.18.4-2, and c in the words of 1985-GR-VI.6.18.4-12 b: a case added (family ruling). 'to': GR17 states the whole rule; §2023:14.9.22.4 GR7 states in its own words that 'each properly matched occurrence of literal-1 is tallied (format 1) or replaced by literal-3 (format 2)', the replacement b spells out.
